reviews_found.author: Christian Ochoa
reviews_found.text: What an outstanding roofing company. They sent a very well and organized team out and they got the Job done and done well. There Price was very fair as well. Would recommend to anyone in the the Miramar area in search of a roofing repair!

reviews_found.author: the_br0
reviews_found.text: Their consumer focused team is the best in Miramar! Thank you for an awesome job Tom! I am thankful for the amazing work that you did! Your service was outstanding. The highly praised services from Dr. Roofix Miramar Roofers. I recommend it to others.

reviews_found.author: Julia Mendez
reviews_found.text: Dr. Roofix Miramar Roofers sent the best team for work I am truy amazed at their skills and comittment. I am impressed with how easy it was to get in touch with you, I had a marvellous time working with them on my project. 10/10 I will continue to use the services. Highly professional.

reviews_found.author: Andrea Ferrera
reviews_found.text: I live in the Miramar area and was in need of a roof repair. I was thinking it would take a while but they did it in no time! The price was fair and they did amazing! I 100% recommend.

reviews_found.author: Nichole Bello
reviews_found.text: 10/10 Service, would definitely recommend to anyone in the Miramar area in need of a roof repair. I was blown away by the professionalism and the efficiency with which they worked.
